name: Basolateral amygdala glutamatergic principal (pyramidal-like) neuron
morphology_summary: Spiny multipolar / pyramidal-like neuron with a dominant apical-like dendrite and spiny dendritic tree; long axons with local collaterals projecting to other amygdala regions and remote cortical/subcortical targets. Constitutes ~80-90% of BLA neurons. In the lateral amygdala, somata often lack a clearly pyramidal shape.
ephys_summary: Classical pyramidal cell firing pattern in slice recordings; identified as the predominant cell class in BLA whole-cell studies. Biocytin fills show pyramidal to stellate cell bodies.
subtypes_noted: Transcriptomic studies (Totty et al., 2024) show glutamatergic pyramidal-like neurons are transcriptionally specialized within the basal, lateral, or accessory basal nuclei. Human/NHP basal nucleus further parcellated into magnocellular (BLmc), intermediate (BLi), and parvicellular (BLpc) subdivisions; rodent BL split into anterior/posterior (BLA/BLP).

name: Basolateral amygdala parvalbumin-positive basket cell
morphology_summary: Perisomatic-targeting inhibitory interneuron innervating principal-cell somata and proximal dendrites. Mutually interconnected via synapses and gap junctions within the PV basket-cell network; avoids innervating CCK basket cells but contacts axo-axonic cells.
ephys_summary: Fast-spiking firing pattern characteristic of cortical PV basket cells; provides powerful perisomatic inhibition controlling principal-neuron spiking.
subtypes_noted: Estimated 17-20% of GABAergic cells in LA/BA. Forms one of two parallel basket-cell networks alongside CCK basket cells.

name: Basolateral amygdala parvalbumin-positive axo-axonic (chandelier) cell
morphology_summary: PV-expressing interneuron targeting the axon initial segment of principal neurons; receives synaptic contacts from both PV and CCK basket cells.
ephys_summary: Fast-spiking PV-class firing pattern (inferred from PV interneuron grouping).
subtypes_noted: Estimated 5.5-6% of GABAergic cells in LA/BA.

name: Basolateral amygdala cholecystokinin/CB1+ basket cell
morphology_summary: Perisomatic-targeting basket cell expressing cholecystokinin and CB1 cannabinoid receptor; innervates principal-cell somata and proximal dendrites alongside PV basket cells. Forms a parallel basket-cell network distinct from the PV network; mutually interconnected within CCK group but does not innervate PV basket cells, while contacting axo-axonic cells.
ephys_summary: Regular/accommodating firing typical of cortical CCK basket cells (inferred from cortical analogue); diverse subclasses identified in basal amygdala.
subtypes_noted: Estimated 7-9% of GABAergic cells in LA/BA. Heterogeneous - several CCK interneuron subclasses identified in the basal amygdala in fear-extinction work.

name: Basolateral amygdala somatostatin-positive dendrite-targeting interneuron
morphology_summary: Dendrite-targeting GABAergic interneuron expressing somatostatin (often co-expressing calbindin in older marker schemes); innervates dendrites of principal neurons rather than perisomatic domains.
ephys_summary: Not explicitly characterized in this report; cortical-like SOM dendrite-targeting profile implied.
subtypes_noted: Estimated 10-16% of GABAergic cells in LA/BA. Distinct from somatostatin/nNOS-expressing GABAergic projection neurons.

name: Basolateral amygdala calbindin-positive dendrite-targeting interneuron
morphology_summary: Calbindin-positive interneurons targeting dendrites of BLA principal cells; characterized in vivo as a distinct dendrite-targeting class separable by marker content from somatostatin dendrite-targeting cells.
ephys_summary: Distinct in vivo firing recruitment relative to hippocampal theta rhythm and noxious stimuli; specific ephys profile not detailed in this report.
subtypes_noted: Overlaps partially with SOM/CB+ interneurons in older marker schemes.

name: Basolateral amygdala NPY-containing neurogliaform cell
morphology_summary: Neurogliaform interneuron expressing NPY, with the densely arborizing axonal field typical of cortical neurogliaform cells.
ephys_summary: Late-spiking firing typical of cortical neurogliaform cells (inferred from cortical analogue); explicit ephys not detailed in this report.
subtypes_noted: Estimated 14-15% of GABAergic cells in LA/BA. Directly identified among BLA interneurons in CCK-Cre targeting studies.

name: Basolateral amygdala VIP/calretinin-expressing interneuron-selective interneuron
morphology_summary: Small bipolar or bitufted interneuron coexpressing calretinin, VIP, and often CCK; preferentially targets other interneurons rather than principal cells.
ephys_summary: Not specifically characterized in this report.
subtypes_noted: Estimated 29-38% of GABAergic cells in LA/BA - the largest GABAergic class. Overlaps with the classical 'small bipolar/bitufted CR/CCK/VIP' subgroup.

name: Basolateral amygdala somatostatin/nNOS-expressing GABAergic projection neuron
morphology_summary: Long-range projecting GABAergic neuron expressing somatostatin and neuronal nitric oxide synthase; distinct from local SOM dendrite-targeting interneurons.
ephys_summary: Distinct in vivo firing pattern relative to hippocampal theta and noxious stimuli (Bienvenu et al., 2012); detailed ephys not characterized.
subtypes_noted: Estimated 5.5-8% of GABAergic cells in LA/BA. Some project to basal forebrain.

name: Central amygdala protein kinase C-delta (PKC-delta) neuron
morphology_summary: GABAergic neuron of the lateral/capsular central amygdala (CeL/CeC) expressing PKC-delta; reciprocally connected with PKC-delta-negative CeL neurons and inhibits CeM output neurons.
ephys_summary: Predominantly late-firing; corresponds to the physiologically defined CeL-OFF population that reduces firing to fear-conditioned stimuli.
subtypes_noted: Largely non-overlapping with SOM+ CeL neurons; together with SOM cells these account for most CeL neurons.

name: Central amygdala somatostatin-positive neuron
morphology_summary: GABAergic somatostatin-expressing neuron of CeL/CeC; receives potentiated excitatory input from lateral amygdala during fear conditioning and inhibits CeL output to disinhibit CeM and drive fear expression (CeL-ON-like role).
subtypes_noted: Largely non-overlapping with PKC-delta neurons; constitutes a large share of lateral CeA neurons.

name: Central amygdala corticotropin-releasing factor (CRF) neuron
morphology_summary: GABAergic CeA population expressing CRF, identified alongside PKC-delta and SOM populations in recent rodent and cross-species work.
subtypes_noted: Often partially overlaps with other neuropeptide-defined CeA populations; not exhaustively characterized here.

name: Central amygdala medium spiny neuron
morphology_summary: Ovoid soma with several primary nonspiny dendrites that branch into spiny secondary and tertiary dendrites; axons begin branching before leaving the nucleus. Predominant cell type in the lateral sector of CeA - the striatal-like principal class.
ephys_summary: Likely overlaps with type A / late-firing classes described in older slice work, though direct mapping not given here.
subtypes_noted: Striatum-like morphology consistent with CeA's striatopallidal-like organization.

name: Central amygdala large aspiny neuron
morphology_summary: Big soma with thick aspiny primary dendrites branching to secondary processes that are only seldom spiny.
ephys_summary: Not specifically characterized in this report.
subtypes_noted: Classical morphological class described alongside medium spiny and small aspiny neurons.

name: Central amygdala small aspiny neuron
morphology_summary: Small soma with aspiny dendrites; third classical morphological cell type of CeA after medium spiny and large aspiny neurons.
ephys_summary: Not specifically characterized in this report.
subtypes_noted: Likely overlaps with fast-spiking internuncial neurons of CeA, though direct mapping not given.

name: Intercalated cell mass FOXP2+ GABAergic interneuron
morphology_summary: Densely packed small GABAergic neuron forming discrete clusters at the borders between basolateral and central amygdala. Often noted for dopamine D1 receptor and mu-opioid receptor expression; recent transcriptomics distinguishes FOXP2+ subtypes specific to ITCs.
ephys_summary: Not characterized in detail in this report.
subtypes_noted: Recent human/NHP transcriptomic work identifies distinct FOXP2+ ITC subtypes; ITCs are treated as a specialized inhibitory population rather than an extension of neighboring nuclei.

name: Medial amygdala glutamatergic projection neuron
anatomy_mentioned: bed nucleus of the stria terminalis
morphology_summary: Pyramidal-like glutamatergic projection neuron of rodent medial amygdala; derived from third-ventricle neuroepithelium and also populates the BST and hypothalamus.
ephys_summary: Heterogeneous slice ephys reported in MeA (pyramidal-like, late-firing, first-firing classes - Niimi et al., 2012); explicit ephys for the glutamatergic subset not isolated.
subtypes_noted: Minority class - MeA is predominantly GABAergic but contains this distinct glutamatergic projection population.
